protocol.name: crucible_window_identity_v1

description.summary: authenticated per-window identity for CDE-spawned terminals

protocol.description: Lets a client that hosts windows on behalf of a CDE-spawned process (the crucible-term daemon) tie one wl_surface to that spawn. The spawn carries a single-use grant in CRUCIBLE_WINDOW_GRANT; the client presents it with bind_surface before the surface gets any role (before get_xdg_surface and get_toplevel), so the identity exists when the compositor places the window.

interface.name: crucible_window_identity_manager_v1

description.summary: binds surfaces to CDE spawn grants

interface.description: The global through which a client binds a surface to a spawn grant.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager object. Existing identity objects are unaffected.

request.name: bind_surface

description.summary: bind a surface to a spawn grant

request.description: Binds surface to the spawn that grant was minted for, with root_pid the process the client forked for this window. Must be sent before the surface has a role. The compositor answers on id with exactly one of bound or rejected. It rejects (never a protocol error) when: the surface already has a role; the grant is unknown, already used, or its spawn has been reaped; the peer UID differs from the compositor UID; the peer executable (trailing " (deleted)" stripped) differs from the canonical executable recorded when the grant was minted; or the parent of root_pid is not the peer process. A grant is consumed by a successful bind.

interface.name: crucible_window_identity_v1
interface.description: Receives exactly one event: bound or rejected.

event.name: bound
event.description: The surface carries the identity window_id from now on.

event.name: rejected
event.description: The bind was refused for reason; the surface stays unbound.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys this object. The surface's identity, if bound, is unaffected.
